description: This file declares an interface for a factory that creates transactional state storage objects in Orleans transactions framework.

classes.name: ITransactionalStateStorageFactory
classes.description: Interface defining a factory for creating transactional state storage instances.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ITransactionalStateStorage for a given state type, state name, and grain context.

parameters.name: stateName
parameters.description: The name of the state storage to create.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: The grain context associated with the storage.
